potionhudx.title: PotionHUD X
potionhudx.subtitle: 5 modes
potionhudx.footer.hint: Scroll to browse · Shift+scroll over a slider for fine steps · Tab switches category
potionhudx.position.hint: Drag the HUD · arrows nudge · Shift+arrows ×10 · C centres · G grid · Esc done
potionhudx.mode.classic.desc: The plain one: icon, name and timer in a list.
potionhudx.mode.compact.desc: Icon strip or grid with a micro timer and duration underline.
potionhudx.mode.bar.desc: Name plus a shrinking duration bar tinted with the effect colour.
potionhudx.mode.liquid_glass.desc: Frosted glass panel with rim light, moving sheen and glass pills.
potionhudx.mode.neon.desc: Dark slab with glowing outline, glow text and scan lines.
potionhudx.sort.name: Name
potionhudx.option.enabled.desc: Master switch for the whole HUD.
potionhudx.option.hide_vanilla.desc: Suppresses Minecraft's own effect icons in the corner.
potionhudx.option.preview.desc: Shows sample effects in game so you can style the HUD without drinking potions.
potionhudx.option.anchor.desc: Corner or edge the HUD sticks to. Ignored while free position is on.
potionhudx.option.free_pos.desc: Place the HUD anywhere with drag & drop instead of an anchor.
potionhudx.option.grow_up.desc: New rows stack above instead of below.
potionhudx.option.scale.desc: Scales the whole HUD, icons and text together.
potionhudx.option.corner_radius.desc: 0 gives sharp corners, higher values round the panel.
potionhudx.option.icon_right.desc: Handy when the HUD sits on the right edge.
potionhudx.option.hide_level_one.desc: Skips effects without an amplifier entirely.
potionhudx.option.hide_ambient.desc: Ambient effects from beacons and conduits are left out.
potionhudx.option.max_rows.desc: Auto fits the rows into the height limit below.
potionhudx.option.overflow.desc: Adds a +N row when effects do not fit.
potionhudx.option.marquee.desc: Names wider than the panel scroll instead of being cut.
potionhudx.option.bg_gradient.desc: Fades from the first colour to the second one.
potionhudx.option.drop_shadow.desc: Soft shadow under the panel, helps it lift off bright scenes.
potionhudx.option.accent_color.desc: Used by bars, glow and progress lines.
potionhudx.option.warn_color.desc: Colour of effects that are about to run out.
potionhudx.option.use_effect_color.desc: Tints each row with the potion's own colour.
potionhudx.option.glass_blur.desc: Layered frosted backdrop behind the glass slab.
potionhudx.option.glass_sheen.desc: Highlight that slowly travels across the glass.
potionhudx.option.glass_refraction.desc: Bright top edge and specular highlight — the wet glass look.
potionhudx.option.neon_glow.desc: Outer halo around the panel, the tick and the text.
potionhudx.option.compact_horizontal.des: Off stacks the icons into a column.
potionhudx.option.compact_columns.desc: Wraps the icons into a grid. Auto keeps a single line.
potionhudx.option.animations.desc: Fade-in, slide-in and the liquid motion of the fancy modes.
potionhudx.option.pulse.desc: Slow breathing of glow and glass highlights.
potionhudx.option.flicker.desc: Blinks the row when the effect is nearly gone.
potionhudx.option.flicker_ticks.desc: Remaining time at which the blinking starts.
potionhudx.option.warn_ticks.desc: Remaining time at which the row turns into the warning colour.
potionhudx.option.profile_name.desc: Saved to config/potionhudx/<name>.json so you can share it.
potionhudx.button.position_editor.desc: Drag the HUD around the screen with snapping.
potionhudx.button.reset.desc: Back to the stock Classic look.
potionhudx.picker.title: Colour
potionhudx.hint.classic: Classic has no extra knobs — use Size, Content and Colors
potionhudx.peek.hint: Click anywhere to bring the settings back
potionhudx.option.glass_see_through.desc: Samples the real frame behind the panel and refracts it, so the scene shows through the glass.
potionhudx.option.glass_distortion.desc: Strength of the liquid wave running through the refracted image.
